name: Collateral Reinvestment
definition: Provides details on the type of the cash reinvestment in a given currency and on the cash reinvestment rate.

CashReinvestmentRate.name: Cash Reinvestment Rate
CashReinvestmentRate.definition: Average interest rate received on cash collateral reinvestment by the lender for reinvestment of cash collateral.

ReinvestedCashType.name: Reinvested Cash Type
ReinvestedCashType.definition: Provides details on the type of the cash reinvestment in a given currency.

FundingSourceType.name: Funding Source Type
FundingSourceType.definition: Information on type of funding sources used as funding to finance a margin loans.

RelatedCollateral.name: Related Collateral
RelatedCollateral.definition: Provides details on the collateral of the cash reinvestment.
